title: Concrete prescribed-point linear systems
statement:
For a scheme X and an invertible module M [def-sc-invertible-module], the jet target
at x is (m_x/m_x^2) tensor over O_X,x with M_x. In a stalk frame e, a section whose
coefficient a lies in m_x has jet [a] tensor e^-1(1); its value outside this vanishing
subspace is set to zero. Vanishing on a finite set means each germ belongs to m_x M_x.
For a k-scheme Y with specified structure map f, a finite family s and coefficients a,
its combination is the sum of the scalars pulled back along f times s_i. Restriction
uses the canonical tensor-pullback unit. Its member on an open X -> Y is the actual
zero scheme [def-pc-zero-scheme] of that restricted combination. For c:Y -> P^N, the
n-th prescribed twist is c^* O(n). These are the unchanged concrete constructions
previously declared in the prescribed-point smooth-system module.
